problem_model.system_description: A web application for managing personal tasks where users can create tasks, mark them complete, and delete them. Built with Python/FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, and vanilla JavaScript frontend.
dependencies: DATABASE_URL environment variable for database connection
Single HTML page with vanilla JavaScript frontend
boundaries: Single HTML page with vanilla JavaScript (no build step)
success_shape: REST JSON API with proper error handling using { "detail": "message" } format
Complete README.md with setup and usage instructions
acceptance_criteria: POST /tasks endpoint accepts { "title": "string" } and returns created task
GET /tasks endpoint returns all tasks with optional ?completed=true/false filter
PATCH /tasks/{id} endpoint accepts { "completed": true } to mark task done
Database has tasks table with id (SERIAL PRIMARY KEY), title (VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL), completed (BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
README.md includes database startup, backend run instructions, API reference, and frontend access
